senses.gloss: शमाह m. a quiet place, hermitage, L.
समह ind. (fr. 1. सम) anyhow, somehow, RV. (accord. to Sāy. voc. of an adj., प्रशस्त, सधन &c.)
समाह्व mfn. having the same name as (comp.), Śiś.
सम्-आह्व m. calling out, mutual calling, challenge, defiance, W.
सम्-आह्व mfn. (fr. सम् + आह्वा) bearing the same name, Śiś.
समाह्वा (आ), f. a kind of plant (= गो-जिह्वा), L.
सम्-आह्वा (आ), f. a partic. plant (= गो-जिह्वा), L.
समहस् w.r. for सु-महस्, q.v.
सम्-महस् n. (prob.) common or mutual joy (see महस्), ŚrS.
स-महाव्रत mfn. having a Mahāvrata day, ĀpŚr.
स-महीधर mfn. having mountains, mountainous, MW.
समह्या (?) f. fame, reputation (cf. सम्-अज्या), L.
सम्-आ॑हित mfn. put or held together, joined, assembled, combined, united (pl. ‘all taken together’), ŚBr.; MBh. &c.
joined or furnished or provided with (instr. or comp.), ib.
put to, added (as fuel to fire), AV.
put or placed in or upon, directed, applied, fixed, imposed, deposited, entrusted, delivered over, ib. &c. &c.
composed, collected, concentrated (as the thoughts upon, with loc.)
one who has collected his thoughts or is fixed in abstract meditation, quite devoted to or intent upon (with loc.), devout, steadfast, firm, Up.; MBh. &c.
put in order, set right, adjusted, R.
suppressed, repressed, lowered (as speech), L.
made, rendered, Hariv.
completed, finished, ended, MBh.
concluded, inferred, demonstrated, established, L.
granted, admitted, recognised, approved, Āpast.; Hariv.
corresponding or equal to, like, resembling (comp.), R.; Hariv.
harmonious, sounding faultlessly, L.
सम्-आ॑हित m. a pure or holy man, MW.
सम्-आ॑हित n. great attention or intentness, MW.
(in rhet.) a partic. kind of comparison, Vām. iv, 3, 29
सम्-आ॑हित See p. 1160, col. 1.
सम्-आहित—धी mfn. one who has concentrated his thoughts in devotion, BhP.
सम्-आहित—मति mfn. one who has an attentive mind, Yājñ., Sch.
सम्-आहित—मनस् mfn. having the mind absorbed in (anything), MW.
सम्-आहित—मनो-बुद्धि mfn. having the mind or thoughts collected or composed, R.
सम्-आ॑हि˚तात्मन् (संआ॑ह्˚), mfn. one whose spirit is united with (instr.), ŚBr.
समाहितिका f. N. of a woman (cf. समाधिमतिका), Mālav.
सम्-आहत mfn. struck together, MBh.
joined, united, Nir.
struck down, wounded, killed, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
beaten (as a drum), Amar.; Kathās.
सम्-आहनन n. the act of striking upon or against, ĀpŚr., Sch.
सम्-आहूत See सम्-आ-√ ह्वे.
सम्-आहूत mfn. called or collected together, assembled, summoned, challenged (to fight or to a game of chance), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
सम्-आहर mfn. crushing together, destroying, R.
सम्-आहार m. seizing, taking hold of Gṛhyās.
aggregation, summing up, sum, totality, collection, assemblage, multitude, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
(in gram.) conjunction or connecting of words or sentences (as by the particle च), Śaṃk.; Prāt., Sch.; Pāṇ., Sch.

compounding of words, a compound (esp. applied to a Dvaṃdva whose last member is in the neuter gender [e.g. अहि-नकुलम्, ‘a snake and an ichneumon’], or to a Dvigu, when it expresses an aggregate; see त्रिलोकी), Pāṇ.
= प्रत्याहार, Vop. (cf. IW. 169 n.)
withdrawal (of the senses from the world), Kām.
contraction, abridgment, L.
सम्-˚आहरण n. bringing together, collection, accumulation, combination, composition, W.
सम्-˚आहर्तृ m. a collector (in अर्थ-स्˚), Mn. vii, 60.
सम्-आहार—वर्ण m. N. of the diphthongs ऐ and औ, Pat.
सम्-˚आहार्य᳙ mfn. to be collected or united or combined, ŚBr.; MBh.
सम्-आहृत mfn. brought together, collected, fetched, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
gathered, assembled, met, Hariv.; Ragh.; BhP.
taken together, contracted, combined, all, Kāś.; Kathās.
drawn (as a bowstring), Kathās.
related, told, BhP.
accepted, received, taken, W.
सम्-˚आहृति f. taking together, collecting (= संग्रह), L.
withdrawal (of the senses) from (abl.), L.
सम्-आ˚हृ॑त्य ind. (taking) together, all at once, TBr.; Kauś.
सम्-आह्वी (ई), f. id., ib.
सम्-˚आह्वय m. challenge, conflict, MBh.
setting animals to fight for sport, betting (esp. betting on animals, as distinguished from gaming with dice &c.; see द्यूत), Mn.; Yājñ.
an appellation, name (also n.), Pañcar.
सम्-आह्वातृ m. one who summons, a challenger to (dat.), MBh.
सम्-आह्वान n. calling upon or together, R.; Pañcat.
summons, challenge (to fight or to grumble), MBh.; R.
betting on the battles of animals, Suśr.
